correctness.rationale: The source-defined autonomous unvaccinated next-generation matrix for one-way mobility is similar to the 2x2 symmetric H(p) with entries a+q/(1+rp), q sqrt(r) p/(1+rp), b(1−qp)+qrp²/(1+rp), q=1−a, b=β2/β1∈(0,1),r=n2/n1>0. Independent symbolic determinant multiplication gave Q(z,p)=(z−1)(z−b)+p[r(z−a)(z−b)+bq(z−1)]−rq(1−b)(z−a)p². Since Q_z on λmax>0 and λmax>a, at every stationary λ=2rq(1−b)(λmax−a)/Q_z>0. Thus no local maxima and at most one stationary minimum; λ′(0)=−rq<0. At r=1,b=1/2 the endpoint formula Q_p(λ(1),1)=q(3a−2)/4 gives phase boundary a=2/3, with equality case endpoint curvature positive (left derivative negative). At a=0, symbolic resultant of Q,Q_p gives p^4−10p²+1, unique interior root sqrt(3)−sqrt(2), and threshold Q(10/11,p)=−(110p²−79p+9)/242 has exactly two p±=(79±sqrt(2281))/220 crossings. Lower eigenvalue <10/11 so roots belong to principal branch. Only linear invasion stability, not nonlinear or periodic. p=1 is a matrix limit, excluded physical domain.
